policy: Expected-success output contracts from executed producer chains, not operation tags alone. source-defined includes explicit dynamic nested fields; runtime-dependent means the actual producer intentionally forwards configured/caller/provider values without an enforceable fixed schema. Default Gson omits null map/object fields but preserves null array entries. Error/delayed Pixel entries remain governed by the existing unchecked runPixel/usePixel success contract.
